SYLLABUS - PSI2316 - Electricity Laboratory II.

This course is composed of weekly experimental classes, lasting 3 hours and 40 minutes each, distributed as follows:

Class	Topic
1	Power and Power Factor Measurements
2	Measurement of Natural Complex Circuit Frequencies
3	Resonant Circuits
4	Three-Phase Circuits
5	Fourier Analysis of Periodical Signals
6	Measurement and Separation of Iron Losses
7	Spectral Analysis
8	Characterization of Magnetic Materials
9	Modeling of Fluorescent Lamps
10	Design of Analog Filters
11	Frequency Response of an Electronic Amplifier
12	Transients in Transmission Lines
